name: labs/bennomeier__cetoni
title: Cetoni Nemesys V4 syringe pump
intro: Cetoni Nemesys V4 syringe pump, adapted from bennomeier/cetoni. It reads `current_position` and `status`; sets `target_position`, `velocity`, `flow_rate` and `valve_position`; runs `pump` and `stop_pump`. `pump`: run a pump at a declared flow rate for a declared duration or volume in a declared direction, reporting the volume moved. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/bennomeier__cetoni --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/bennomeier__cetoni --backend fake --mcp
